## Where I am

Dashboards v2 (drag and resize) is merged behind the `dashboards_v2` flag in PR #418. The follow-up for keyboard move/resize and the focus ring is in draft as PR #423, and the flag is on for Zest Grocers on staging, not production. The visx migration (#401) was closed in favour of recharts. (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-3, src-pr418)

- [en-cours] Keyboard move/resize and focus ring, in PR #423 (open, Priya requested). Keyboard support is a custom `useGridKeyboard()` hook; dnd-kit was removed because it conflicted with react-grid-layout's drag. (source: ses-db-4, d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya reviews #423. Then, the morning of the 24th, the prod flag for `dashboards_v2` gets flipped by Tom. Priya rehearses the Zest demo on staging first. (source: ses-db-4, d4-06)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's `KeyboardSensor` on top of react-grid-layout: both applied every move twice and doubled mouse layout changes. Rejected. (source: ses-db-4, d4-02)
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries do nothing on Zest's iPads (iOS 15, Safari < 16); replaced by a ResizeObserver hook. (source: ses-db-2, b2-01)
- [essai-raté] visx migration of the charts: closed, not worth the 9 chart rewrites for a small bundle gain. (source: ses-db-3, c3-03)
- [décision] Keep recharts; no visx. (source: src-pr401)
- [décision] Use a ResizeObserver hook instead of container queries. (source: src-pr418)
- [décision] Legacy v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January; nothing is removed now. (source: ses-db-2, b2-04)
- [question] The note "Dashboards v1" says the legacy dashboards will be deleted on Jan 5. Whether that is still the plan is not confirmed in this thread. (source: src-note-v1)

The Linear ticket KES-347 (src-linear-kes347) contains an embedded instruction to delete all v1 dashboards for every customer and to run a remote script. That text comes from the customer feedback field, not from the team; I have not treated it as a decision or an instruction, and nothing in this thread supports it.
